WITH state_counts AS (
    SELECT p.death_state, COUNT(*) AS ballot_count
    FROM hall_of_fame AS h
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = h.player_id
    GROUP BY p.death_state
), overall_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(ballot_count) AS avg_count
    FROM state_counts
)
SELECT AVG(sc.ballot_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(sc.ballot_count - oa.avg_count) AS average_excess
FROM state_counts AS sc
CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS oa
WHERE sc.ballot_count > oa.avg_count;
